apiKeyCreatedByOwner.description:
Whether the workspace Owner has created a conversion tracking API key. API keys are account-level resources always created by the account they belong to, so existence implies the Owner created it. The key value itself is never exposed.

On the dedicated `/workspaces/{workspace_id}/conversion-tracking` endpoint
this is always a boolean (the endpoint is restricted to owner/admin).
On the workspaces list (`include=conversionTracking`) it is a boolean for
workspaces where the caller has the `owner` or `admin` role, and `null`
for lower roles (the field is always present).

info.description:
# Rebrandly API Documentation

The Rebrandly API allows you to programmatically create, update, and manage your branded short links,
custom domains, workspaces, and analytics.

## Base URL

All API requests should be made to:
```
https://api.rebrandly.com/v1
```

## Authentication

The Rebrandly API uses API keys for authentication. You can obtain your API key from your
[Rebrandly account settings](https://app.rebrandly.com/account/api-keys).

Include your API key in the request header:
```
apikey: YOUR_API_KEY
```

## Rate Limiting

API requests are rate-limited based on your subscription plan. Rate limit information is included
in response headers:
- `X-RateLimit-Limit`: Total requests allowed per period
- `X-RateLimit-Remaining`: Requests remaining in current period
- `X-RateLimit-Reset`: Time when the rate limit resets (Unix timestamp)

## Multi-Tenancy and Workspaces

Most Rebrandly API resources (links, domains, scripts, tags) are organized into **Workspaces**.
To access resources in a specific workspace, you must include the `Workspace` header with the workspace's unique ID.

```
Workspace: YOUR_WORKSPACE_ID
```

If the `Workspace` header is omitted, the request will be processed in your **Default Workspace**.

tags.description:
Link management endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting branded short links.

**Core Functionality:**
- Create branded short links with custom slashtags
- Auto-generate slashtags if not provided
- Redirect to destination URLs
- Track clicks and analytics
- Support link rules, rotators, and scripts

**Authorization:**
- All link operations require authentication via `apikey` header
- Most operations require `Workspace` header to specify the workspace context
- Link modifications require `owner` or `admin` role (or link creator)

**Features:**
- `links.notes`: Allows `description` field on links
- Link TTL calculated based on workspace features and account plan
